svg.title: One device-tree property moved console start from 10.23 s to 0.060 s
svg.desc: Dot plot on a log scale: console start time for 21 boots. With the framebuffer on disp_cpu the console starts at about 10.23 s; with disp_fe at about 0.06 s. In the controlled pair v4ctl and v4, which differ only in the DTB, the difference is 170-fold. Bar chart below: 24 power-domain errors per boot with disp_cpu, 20 with disp_fe, and 0 from boot 12, where the DTB, kernel and initramfs changed together.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: FIG. 1 · STAGE 1 · FIRST BRING-UP NIGHT, 26–27 SEP 2026
